title: A builder's shell write into the workflows folder is judged like an Edit
why: A builder's `sed -i` on a glob under .github/workflows (`*`, `c*`, `.github/work*/checks.yml`) is allowed, and so are rsync, `yq -i`, `dd of=` and touch into the folder, while the Edit path judges workflow content.
note: Coordinator ruling 18:58 CST Nov 7. Stacked on #1688. Note builder-workflow-glob-unread in docs/debts/notes.md (on #1688) points here. Red tests started 18:59 CST.
